name: Spare Need, Spare Request, RMA, Stock, Fault Tag
foundation_dependencies: LLD-03 Service Request and Device Reference identity/context
LLD-05 Task identity, reviewed outcome/correction and Inventory participant contracts
LLD-08 optional Installed Component resolution provider
scope: Device Part Unit operational component identity
SR-level aggregated Spare Need and contributors
local Stock/Spare Part Unit identity and eligibility
Spare Request draft/allocation/submission identity and immutable requested-logistics snapshots
RMA C10 obligation identity, deterministic assignment, direct inbound unit, current lifecycle projection and return-unit selection
actual logistics/custody events and independently addressable participants
reviewed maintenance physical consequences downstream of Task review
Fault Tag false-submission correction, correction-replacement and rejection-resend lineage
manual lifecycle paths and communication-derived proposal participant interfaces
transaction_boundaries: Normalization, compatibility/duplicate search, bulk preflight, destructive preview and communication proposal calculation occur outside writer transactions and bind exact revisions/fingerprints for commit-time revalidation.

Every standalone Inventory mutation uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt; authoritative event/relationship mutation, current/attention projection rebuild and required audit commit atomically or roll back together.

Spare Request accepted submission freezes one immutable snapshot/allocation set per accepted submission event; a false-submission correction preserves that snapshot and may restore Draft, while any later real submission receives a distinct immutable snapshot.

RMA authorization batch creation, C10 aliases, deterministic preassignment and request authorization projection commit atomically; partial authorization is a valid committed batch, not a partial failed transaction.

Direct inbound receipt creates the physical Spare Part Unit, direct-RMA relationship, receipt/logistics participants, unit lifecycle evidence and projections in one UnitOfWork so no provisional/orphan receipt state can survive.
Reviewed Task physical consequence and any derived RMA return selection commit in the same Inventory UnitOfWork after exact upstream Task review revalidation; Inventory never writes Task lifecycle.

Fault Tag first submission freezes one tag snapshot plus exact member snapshots/events/exclusivity rows atomically; material submitted correction creates a separate replacement tag transactionally, while genuine resend creates separate forward history.

Warehouse bulk receipt/final decision appends one independently addressable membership event per intended target under one batch and is all-or-nothing for the accepted compatible scope; final accepted decision closes the matching RMA obligation in the same UnitOfWork.
LLD-05 retry and LLD-09 proposal participant calls reuse the caller's outer UnitOfWork/command context and never create nested receipts/commits.
failure_modes: identifier allocator or SR7/C10 alias conflict fails before any reusable/duplicate identity can commit
cross-SR Need/request chains, incompatible RMA targets, duplicate active reservations and duplicate active submitted return memberships fail closed
stale Task review, physical consequence or return-selection inputs abort the complete Inventory mutation rather than fabricate physical history
submission snapshot, RMA batch, direct receipt, logistics participant, Fault Tag snapshot or warehouse result failure rolls back every earlier write in that command
communication evidence remains proposal-only; stale/reindexed evidence never mutates Inventory until exact target acceptance revalidates
warehouse final acceptance/rejection cannot be auto-accepted from communication and always requires explicit operator confirmation
bulk target drift aborts the selected mutation rather than silently skipping/coercing targets
cross-domain dependency INDETERMINATE blocks Task hard delete, retry clone or Inventory hard delete rather than degrading to CLEAR
false-submission correction is blocked once real downstream evidence contradicts the claim; actual submitted membership requires replacement rather than in-place edit
projection corruption/rebuild failure does not create lifecycle evidence; authoritative mutation rolls back or deterministic rebuild restores projection from append-oriented facts
review_evidence: Device Part Unit registration and Need aggregation enforce one active SR+BOM aggregate while preserving every contributor and planned quantity independently.
Stock is an indexed eligibility projection over immutable physical units/current reservations and never an auto-consumption quantity ledger.

Spare Request requester is an immutable reusable Contact relationship with bounded creation-time context, distinct from receiver logistics; active/nonterminal requester dependency blocks Contact archival while terminal history preserves requester evidence.
Spare Request draft logistics and allocations are persisted separately from immutable accepted submission snapshots; corrected false submissions can be followed by a later distinct real snapshot.
SR7/C10 are globally non-reusable business identifiers with immutable former aliases while internal entity identities remain stable.

RMA authorization preserves accepted response order, deterministic target assignment, partial progress and one typed current return obligation; an actual physical inbound unit exists only after accepted receipt.

Reviewed Task outcome is consumed only through exact LLD-05 read authority; Inventory records separate reviewed physical consequence and can supersede it after upstream correction without writing Task state.
Requested logistics snapshot and actual logistics/custody events remain separate, and shared logistics participants are independently correctable.
Fault Tag submission locks exact membership/history; warehouse receipt and final decision are distinct; final rejection keeps the obligation open; replacement and resend use separate typed lineage.
Manual paths require no uploaded evidence and Beta 1.0 exposes no manual attachment/upload control.
Communication evidence remains proposal-only and cannot auto-accept warehouse or physical lifecycle transitions.

V2 retrofit assigns every route a canonical /api/v1/inventory path, exact request/response contract, LLD-12 auth policy, request bound and stable error surface while preserving Inventory's downstream-only relationship to Task lifecycle.
Granularity split preserves all original Spare Request/RMA and Fault Tag tables while making the aggregate schema files normative indexes with semantically owned leaves.

The review-ready closure layer now includes explicit migration object allocation, implementation module ownership, lifecycle transition machines, split route/type contracts, command/query trace fragments and complete governing requirement coverage without changing approved Inventory semantics.
design_principle: Inventory preserves demand, provider obligations, physical units, planning allocations, actual physical consequences, requested logistics, actual logistics and return attempts as separate authorities. Every accepted transition is append-oriented and identity-preserving; availability, communication evidence, Task outcome or warehouse receipt alone never silently imply another lifecycle fact.
